text:
maria: Heads-up from onboarding: a new hire hit a blocker in sampleapp when we rotated creds. They swapped REDWOOD_API_KEY but left REDWOOD_PROJECT unset and hit auth errors.
aj: What error text did they see?
maria: `401: Invalid key scope for request. expected project=prod` from sdk /requests. No other logs.
leo: Hmm, our sampleapp README mentions REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG but nowhere spells REDWOOD_PROJECT (only in advanced config). That mismatch is bad.
taylor: Also found divergence: Go SDK reads REDWOOD_PROJECT (ok), Java SDK reads REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME, and the CLI accepts --project flag. Parity gap.
aj: Surprise combinations: if someone rotates API key to a project-scoped key but tool uses the wrong env var name, it looks like key suddenly stopped working.
maria: New hire steps: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=newkey; unset REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME; run sampleapp -> instant 401. They couldn't repro locally because their machine had both env vars set.
leo: Two action items: 1) SDK parity: accept both REDWOOD_PROJECT and REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME, and prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT. 2) sampleapp should validate at startup and surface a clear error.
taylor: Also a retry nuance: ephemeral tokens in CI produce transient 401 during rotation window. Current retry logic treats 401 like a transient network error -> retries forever. We should mark 401/403 as fatal unless response includes Retry-After or Retryable-Auth header.
aj: Agree. Proposal: SDK auth layer: if status in [401,403] and no Retry-After -> return clear AuthError w/ hint "check REDWOOD_PROJECT env var or --project" and do not attempt retries. If header present, respect Retry-After.
maria: I'll PR sampleapp README to list env vars and add a small startup check that errors with "missing project scope: set REDWOOD_PROJECT".
leo: I'll open parity PRs across SDKs. Will include a unit test that simulates env var permutations.
taylor: Ops: can we add a brief onboarding smoke job that runs sampleapp in CI with only REDWOOD_API_KEY set to catch this class early?
ops-bot: CI: onboarding-smoke #452 started
aj: Thanks. Also update the onboarding doc + quick troubleshooting snippet: how to detect a scope issue (server 401 + header "x-redwood-expected-scope: project").
maria: Putting a low-sev onboarding incident, tagging devex and docs. We'll aim docs patch within today and SDK fixes in next patch release.
leo: ETA: parity PRs in next 4 hours. Will link once ready.
maria: Great. Closing loop after PRs and CI run passes.
